The '''Hidden Cave''' was located in [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Nightsister fortress]] and was the home of [[Daka/Legends|Old Daka]] when she summoned the [[Army of the Dead/Legends|Army of the Dead]] to destroy the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. Normally accessible only by [[Magic/Legends|magic]], the cave was breached during the battle when a commando droid blasted it open with a rocket launcher, allowing [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] to murder Old Daka and disrupt Talzin's torture of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].<ref name="Massacre" />
